blocks.text: Simple harmonic motion oscillation ya vibration ki woh type (qism) hai jo restoring force (wapas lane wali force) ke asar se paida hoti hai.
Simple harmonic motion hone ke liye yeh conditions (shartein) zaroori hain:

items: Restoring force mean position se displacement ke directly proportional (seedhe tanasub mein) ho: displacement dugna to force bhi dugni.
Body (jism) mein inertia (mass) ho, taa ke woh mean position par ruk na jaye balke us se aage nikal jaye. (Force inertia ke proportional nahi hoti; neeche 'Kitab ki ghalti' dekhein.)
Force aur displacement Hooke's law (F = −kx) ke mutabiq hon. k spring constant hai, jo spring ke material ki nature par depend karta hai.
Jhoolti cheez ka acceleration displacement ke proportional ho: a ∝ −x. Minus ka nishaan batata hai ke acceleration hamesha mean position ki taraf hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki list mein do ghaltiyan hain. (1) Kitab likhti hai ke restoring force body ki inertia ke proportional ho; yeh sahi nahi. Restoring force sirf displacement par depend karti hai (F = −kx). Inertia ki zaroorat is liye hai ke body mean position se aage nikal sake, lekin force inertia ke proportional nahi hoti. (2) Kitab mein '(α–x)' chhapa hai; sahi a ∝ −x hai, yani '∝' (proportional ka nishaan), α (alpha) nahi.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Har periodic vibration simple harmonic motion nahi hoti, kyun ke har restoring force displacement ke proportional nahi hoti. Koi bhi restoring force oscillation paida kar sakti hai. Electrocardiogram (ECG) dhadakte dil ka periodic pattern (naqsha) banata hai, lekin us ki recorder needle ki motion S.H.M nahi, kyun ke wahan restoring force hamesha mean position se displacement ke proportional nahi hoti.

blocks.prompt: Ek cheez aage peeche jhoolti hai lekin us ka acceleration displacement ke proportional nahi. Kya yeh S.H.M hai?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Yeh oscillatory (aur periodic) motion ho sakti hai, lekin S.H.M ke liye a = −(constant) × x, yani a ∝ −x, zaroori hai.

items: S.H.M: restoring force displacement ke proportional aur mean position ki taraf, F = −kx.
Acceleration a ∝ −x; minus ka matlab: hamesha mean position ki taraf.
Har S.H.M periodic hai, lekin har periodic motion S.H.M nahi (misal: ECG needle).
